title: KonoSuba Season 4 Reveals Key Visual, Studio Change, 2027 Release
content: KonoSuba: God’s Blessing on This Wonderful World Season 4 revealed a new key visual, along with a 2027 release date and main staff. The new sequel was first announced after the BONUS STAGE OVA episodes on March 14, 2025.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Ogre's Bride Anime Casts Akira Ishida, Misato Fukuen
content: The staff for the television anime of Kureha 's The Ogre's Bride ( Oni no Hanayome ) light novel series revealed on Sunday that Akira Ishida and Misato Fukuen have been added in the anime's cast. The new cast members' characters appeared in the anime's fourth episode on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Star Detective Precure! Anime Film Reveals Main Trailer, Staff Members, Ending Song
content: The staff for Eiga Meitantei Precure! Fushigi na Niwa to Futari no Himitsu ( Star Detective Precure! The Movie: The Mysterious Garden and the Secret of 2 People) — the film for Star Detective Precure! , the 23rd main anime entry in the Precure franchise — revealed the film's main trailer and staff members on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Marvel, WEBTOON Announce 3 Original Vertical-Scroll Series at SDCC
content: Marvel Comics and WEBTOON announced three original webcomic series created exclusively for WEBTOON during Marvel's Next Big Thing panel at San Diego Comic-Con on Friday. title: Marvel Partners With Kadokawa for Upcoming Manga Projects
content: Manga creator tokitokoro ( Lynx, River in Me, Jeff the Land Shark ) confirmed on X/Twitter on Saturday that Marvel Comics is partnering with Kadokawa for upcoming manga adaptations.
author: ANN

title: KonoSuba – God's blessing on this wonderful world! 4 Anime Reveals Staff, 2027 Debut
content: "Colorful," the 10th anniversary event for the KonoSuba – God’s blessing on this wonderful world!! anime, revealed on Sunday the fourth season of the anime, titled KonoSuba – God's blessing on this wonderful world! 4 , will air in 2027.
author: ANN

title: hololive Birmingham Concert Screening on September 17
content: Tickets are available for a screening of the concert film hololive English 4th Concert -Serendipity- on Thursday September 17 at Cineworld Birmingham NEC . Attendees can register for a place at https://www.serendipityscreening.com/ .

title: Ani-One India Streams The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World Anime
content: Anime Times is also streaming the series in India. The anime debuted on AT-X on July 6 at 11:00 p.m. JST, then on BS NTV at 24:00 JST, and on CBC TV at 25:37 JST (effectively, July 7 at 12:00 midnight and 1:37 a.m. JST, respectively). The series then aired on Tokyo MX on July 7.
